name: QA engineer
summary: Writes the tests and test plans that catch bugs before customers do, and bug reports developers can act on.

changelog.note: First release: 30 sources (Playwright 1.65 and Cypress 16.2.1 docs, flaky test research, WCAG 2.2 with axe and manual checks, Mozilla bug guidelines, TSB and CrowdStrike cases), four skills (risk-based test plan, automated test suite, bug report and triage, accessibility test pass), six prompts, three workflows, training interview and test briefs.
